pnpm.//overrides: Patch high-severity transitive CVEs (pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high). Ranges target only the vulnerable versions. Every entry except deepmerge-ts is a patch bump within its major line, so no framework major is forced; that one exception is explained below.
pnpm.//overrides-deepmerge-ts: GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx (high: stack exhaustion merging recursive object graphs), reached through @prisma/client>prisma>@prisma/config. The ONE override that crosses a major (7.1.5 -> 8.0.1): the fix first ships in 8.0.0, and Prisma 7.9.1 (latest) still pins 7.1.5, so there is no in-major bump to take. Only the Prisma CLI reaches this code, loading prisma.config.ts, which `pnpm db:generate` exercises. REMOVE once Prisma depends on deepmerge-ts >=8.
pnpm.//overrides-fastify: Deduplication, not a CVE patch: @nestjs/platform-fastify bundles its own fastify, so a direct fastify bump in apps/api produces TWO copies and two incompatible FastifyInstance types — the @fastify/* plugins then fail to typecheck against the app's instance. Forcing one version keeps them in lockstep. Stay within the 5.x line NestJS supports.
